summary: Listed at Canada Lookouts in Bulkley-Nechako with coordinates and elevation only; no history, staffing or condition source found.
notes_for_editor: No story written: the only source is one listing with coordinates and elevation (no unit given; the brief reads 1636 as metres). Two WebSearch calls and the regional lookout pages found no Red Fern entry, and the sibling site canadafirelookouts.weebly.com has no page for it. Possible confusion with Redfern-Keily Provincial Park, which is in far northern BC and unrelated. A BC Archives or Forest History Association search is needed before a story can reach the 120-word floor.
